boundary: Single-host dry run: all three quorum-log node processes, the fault injection, and the client ran on one machine over loopback. This validates the harness only. It is not multi-host evidence, no remote host was contacted, and nothing here measures a network between machines.

events.name: new_leader_elected
events.detail: node 2 took over from killed node 1

events.name: restart_killed_node
events.detail: node 1 restarted from its persisted state

events.name: cluster_settled
events.detail: all three nodes report the same leader again

events.name: isolate_follower
events.detail: node 1 blackholed from nodes [2 3] in both directions; chaos state: {"node_id":1,"drop_inbound":[2,3],"drop_outbound":[2,3]}

events.name: clear_follower_isolation
events.detail: node 1 reconnected before the leader is isolated, so a quorum can still exist

events.name: cluster_settled
events.detail: all three nodes report the same leader again

events.name: isolate_leader
events.detail: leader node 2 blackholed from nodes [1 3] in both directions; chaos state: {"node_id":2,"drop_inbound":[1,3],"drop_outbound":[1,3]}

events.name: new_leader_elected
events.detail: node 1 elected while node 2 was isolated

events.name: restore_network
events.detail: every chaos isolation cleared on all three nodes

events.name: cluster_healed
events.detail: all three nodes agree on leader node 1

events.name: restart_all_ready
events.detail: all three nodes restarted from disk and agree on leader node 1

events.name: verify_acknowledged_writes
events.detail: 522 acknowledged writes re-read with linearizable reads; 0 missing or changed

leader_kill_write_outage.method: client-observed: last acknowledged write returning before the event to the first acknowledged write returning after it

leader_kill_election.method: driver polled /status until a node other than the killed node 1 reported itself leader

follower_isolation_progress.method: acknowledged client operations returning inside the fault window, measured by the driver

leader_isolation_write_outage.method: client-observed: last acknowledged write returning before the event to the first acknowledged write returning after it

leader_isolation_election.method: driver polled /status on the majority until one of them reported itself leader while node 2 was isolated

restart_ready_recovery.method: from the stop signal to all three nodes ready and agreeing on one leader

restart_first_read_recovery.method: from the stop signal to the first successful linearizable read after the restart

notes: client traffic and fault injection both ran from this driver; every timestamp is on the driver's clock
